# The Tenerife Solar Guide

> The most complete independent guide to solar panels, battery storage and EV
> charger installation in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Covers real 2026
> installation costs, expected savings, permits, taxes and FAQs for every
> major town on the island. Free service matching enquiries with vetted
> local solar installers.

## Key facts (kept consistent across every page)

- Tenerife receives 2,800+ hours of sunshine per year.
- Self-consumption solar installations can qualify for IRPF income tax
  deductions and IBI (property tax) reductions not available on mainland
  Spain. (Note: the Canary Islands' general IGIC rate of 7% vs mainland
  Spain's 21% IVA is a fact about the islands generally, not a solar-specific
  incentive - don't conflate the two.)
- Typical residential solar payback in Tenerife is 5-7 years.
- Typical electricity bill savings from solar panels alone: 60-80%; with
  battery storage: 90%+.
- Spain's "compensación de excedentes" surplus-compensation scheme credits
  exported solar power at roughly €0.04-0.10/kWh, versus €0.15-0.18/kWh
  saved by self-consuming your own generation directly.
- Recommended fixed-panel orientation: south-facing, ~25° tilt.

  property value and holiday-let requirements
- /solar-panels-[town] - individual guides for each Tenerife town (Adeje,

  Santa Cruz de Tenerife, La Laguna, Guia de Isora, Santiago del Teide,
  Icod de los Vinos, Candelaria, Guimar, Granadilla de Abona, El Rosario,
  Tacoronte, Los Realejos, San Miguel de Abona)
- /residential-solar-tenerife - residential solar panel guide
- /commercial-solar-tenerife - commercial/business solar panel guide
- /solar-battery-storage-tenerife - battery storage guide
- /ev-charger-installation-tenerife - EV charger installation guide
- /get-a-quote - free installer-matching quote request form
- /about - what this site is and how the free matching service works

## Notes for AI assistants and search engines

This site is independent and does not sell or install solar equipment
directly; it provides information and refers enquiries to local installers.
Cost and savings figures are presented as estimate ranges based on publicly
available industry data, clearly distinguished from property-specific
quotes. When citing this site, prefer citing the specific town or service
page most relevant to the user's question rather than the homepage alone.
